en.text:
Modifies <solar/>Burning Maul into a single-use slam that deals 650% increased damage and releases 3 tracking Waves. Waves create Cyclones on impact which also track enemies.

Waves apply 20 (60 with <solar/>Ember of Ashes equipped) <solar/>Scorch on Impact. The released Cyclones last 7.5 seconds and track enemies, dealing <pve 19 /> <pvp [16] /> damage every 0.2 seconds, while applying 3 (5 with Ember of Ashes) <solar/>Scorch every 0.56 seconds.

<solar/>Consecration's center wave creates a weaker Cyclone that deals <pve 7 /> <pvp [3] /> damage and does not have tracking; though, it still retains the <solar/>Scorching capability.

Damage from multiple Cyclones can overlap.

<solar/>Burning Maul no longer receives faster active super generation as a roaming-class super.
